title: ICTS Postdoctoral Program 2027
institution: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, International Centre for Theoretical Sciences
body:
ICTS invites applications for postdoctoral positions.

Outstanding applicants may be considered for a special Postdoctoral Prize Fellowship: Ashok & Gita Vaish Postdoctoral Fellowship that provides a fellowship enhancement along with additional support for travel and research expenses.

This hiring cycle will also provide selected candidates with an opportunity to apply for the ANRF National Postdoctoral Fellowship (N-PDF) in the subsequent application cycle.

https://www.icts.res.in/academic/postdoctoral-fellowships
